limits: A resolved profile set is not a placement, a reservation or an authorization
Production activation still requires separate recorded authorization
Dedicated edge context is still an internal boundary, not public exposure
Elevated assurance requires recovery evidence that this repository cannot produce
Zone separation is not an automatic failover guarantee
Only internal IPv4 OZ/RZ composition is implemented
Sizing is a request, not a native capacity confirmation
Protection class is requested; native storage policy qualification remains external
A region profile is a filter over reviewed inventory, not a capacity promise
Registration is a declared handoff; the writer's own confirmation remains external
Time-source accuracy is an external operating obligation
Directory reachability and trust configuration remain owner responsibilities
Retention and tamper protection remain owner responsibilities
An exercised restore remains an external recovery obligation
Declared recovery is not an exercised restore; recovery evidence remains external
Capability names alone do not prove enforcement scope, mode or routing isolation; scoped property observations and independent native qualification are required
This profile targets x86_64; changing ISA requires a separately reviewed application rebuild, not disk conversion
